caption: This tonkotsu ramen features a creamy yellow, glossy broth with visible noodles and toppings. Served in a white ceramic bowl with black geometric pattern and Japanese text, it rests on a wooden table with a light brown grain pattern.

segments_info.text: Wooden table surface shows light brown grain pattern with subtle texture and natural wood finish.
The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is creamy yellow, glossy, and contains visible noodles and toppings.
White ceramic ramen bowl with black geometric pattern and Japanese text along its rim.
